# Spectral.js GLSL

`spectral.glsl` is the unmodified GLSL implementation from Spectral.js 3.0.0:
https://github.com/rvanwijnen/spectral.js/blob/3.0.0/shader/spectral.glsl

Copyright (c) 2025 Ronald van Wijnen. MIT license; the complete notice is retained
at the top of the shader. This is the GPU counterpart of the existing
`spectral.js@3.0.0` dependency used by the CPU reference/export renderer.
